content.short: Alchemy provides blockchain APIs, data services, and developer tooling for apps building across many supported chains.
content.description: Alchemy is a blockchain infrastructure platform that gives developers access to standard RPC endpoints, indexed data services, wallet tooling, simulation, and other building blocks used in production apps. Its docs organize the stack into Chain APIs for direct network access, Data APIs for enriched queries, and wallet products for account abstraction and transaction flows. Alchemy supports Mantle alongside a large set of other EVM and non EVM networks, which makes it useful for teams shipping multi chain products without operating their own node and indexing infrastructure from scratch.
content.meta: Alchemy supplies RPC, data, and wallet infrastructure for apps building on Mantle and many other chains. Explore Alchemy on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
